author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: User-style figure (round head over a round-shouldered body) passing between two tall gate panels, like the reference's head, body and two rounded panels. The current drawing used a stick torso with a split foot between two outlined pills, reading as the characters 0|0.
omissions: The body is narrower than the reference's (8 wide) because the 40-unit width must also hold two 8-wide panels and two 8-unit gaps; panel corners are square to keep them distinct from the round-shouldered body.
